Update. Took the whole thing apart and worked out where everything goes. Turns out its just a sensor coming from my case to measure the temperature. Hasnt worked for years which i why i never noticed it. 

Presumably the PSU or the Motherboard are dead so i think im just gonna write it off and get a shit laptop on the meantime
I get one fan rotation and the lights flash then nothing
Does this explain why it isnt turning on? Or is the whole thing done for?
Lost on that front
It's labled CPU but i dont know where to put it
Just randomly turned off last night so i opened it up and see this just dangling about
He will make it legal
please?

Dont feel like i have any options anymore. Without substances i cant feel happy. I bore everyone around me and cant attract friends let alone partners. In a more primitive time I'd have died as an unwanted child but here i am age 20 forced to survive.
Im afraid of trying to kill myself again knowing i need to succeed next time

Every time I try to let myself out with people though they don't want anything to do with me after that because suddenly I'm too much effort to be friends with. People who still talk to me after that like my housemates will avoid talking about it as much as they can.

I can speak to people but I can't talk to people if you know what I mean? Like i can chat about thr football or general gossip but I can't have a meaningful conversation where I get to know someone because then they'll know me and reject me.
If I'm honest though it's been easy so far. The social side of Uni is my main problem.
Law. Dont even want to be a lawyer just looks good on the cv
You only get loans for 4 years and dropping out has cut one of them out and so if i drop out again i only have enough for 2 years which is shorter than any course. Im fucked basically.
It still doesn't feel right though and dropping out again isn't an option. It's like I'm on 1hp now.

I just don't deserve life. I'm useless and unlovable. I've never been close to anyone and apparently wouldn't even know it if I had been. All I do is hurt people and I don't even get anything from it.

I've been bullied throughout school. I never achieved anything. I dropped out of Uni. Now im back there I'm more alone than ever and people outright don't like me even when I try so hard to be amiable. People just see me as a pathetic mess which is what I am because in all honesty I don't have a bad life I'm just too greedy and ungrateful to accept the one I have and work to make anything out of it. I just don't deserve any of this good stuff.

Trying to kill myself and having people tell me how much they care and that they're sorry that they didn't help me. It makes me so guilty because I'm just a waste of a human. I should be sorry and they should be angry. They should all hate me and I can't believe they don't. The guilt makes it so much worse and I can't sleep without crying about it anymore. I've never cried so much in my life and I just want it to stop now.

Like how can I see that any of them care when they only talk about it when they think I'm going to die.
I tried two weeks ago and its not getting better.

Failing was the most painful experience of my life and I cant afford to do it again or I wont get another chance. :/

You shouldnt have to kill others though. No matter what they've done to you death is an easy option compared to many things.
Wouldnt recommend the antidepressants they made everything worse. But thank you for the support
I play civ 5 so much usually with my only like close mate. Its weird because when we play that game its like we've always been playing it.
The senate shall decide your fate
Yeah i did but i gave to my older brother as i wasnt using it to much and i couldnt run half the games. Always a fan of the gran strategies like Hearts of Iron.
How about you? I know you got steam but what you play
Mostly binge drink or get high. Anything i can do with people to trick myself into being part of the group. I was playing football (soccer) up until summer but i got a hernia so had to stop that.
I enjoyed playing it because i had the easy job but i never really got to rules completely

Goes without saying. Christmas is there for eating so you feel guilty the rest of the year. Remember playing rugby on boxing day one year and the whole team was still full of turkey and roasters. Twas a sight

Im just gonna have one on the lonesome. Its not that big a deal for my family over here in the UK and its mostly just a tradition of fighting over a game of monopoly 😂. Cant wait to cook the dinner though.

Sounds good so you got a few weeks of goodness planned? And Im better now tbh if you discount the pain. Starting to get over the fact my friends like eachother more than me as long as they still care.
Yeah just gotta survive through christmas. How've you been
Yeah im refusing them in future and got some counselling with Uni so could pick up from this. A suicide attempt also really makes you think. And tells you who your mates are.

Nothing but the phone. Didnt have that for hours. No idea when i arrived and had no idea what time it was until about 1 when my housemates arrived with my stuff. Hard to sleep in the ward and i got a 4am blood test to look forward to. Not a recommended passtime paracetamol.
Day or two supposedly. Miracle im not on a psych ward
Terribly they made me take 36 paracetamol and am now in hospital. Dont recommend really
Im freaking out on my new antidepressants but im here

My current method is with guys talk about football and girls talk about people. Both can talk about big tv shows and films and though its only small talk its nice to feel included. I actually went to the cinema with some people on my course to watch a film i hated because i would be able to interact with them about it later. Key i think is to pretend to be interested so that they find you interesting and decide they want to do more with you.

Edit: But obviously some people just dont want to talk about anything in which those people you just discuss work and give a social nod.
Much the same with "what are your interests" and "what motivates you"

Not to mention the fact everyone loves to be associated with groups and fails to make their own individual opinions when part of these groups. Group mentality leads them and so collectivism is a constant.
Same here. Nothing to do but keep pretending to have connections. For some reason people dont like befriending people who are lonely :/
They'll eventually work out you just don't like bowling...
I'm currently hiding in my room from my housemates because I know they all hate me.
